title: Reinforced random walks with geometric inter-transition times
summary: We consider interacting vertex-reinforced random walks on a finite graph, each transitioning according to independent geometric holding times of parameter $p_i \in (0,1]$. Letting $x=X(n)$ be the vector of vertex-occupation proportions up to time $n$, the one-step transition probabilities of walk $i$ are governed by $Q^i(x,p_i)=p_iΠ^i(x)+(1-p_i)I$, where $Π^i(x)$ has rows equal to a probability measure $π^i(x)$ on the vertex set and $I$ is the identity.
